meta.description: Recruitment intelligence for football. Contextual percentiles measured against a stated peer group, role fits, statistical similarity and ranked shortlists - with the reasoning behind every result kept visible.

hero.title: Recruitment decisions need context, not just statistics.
hero.body: A scouting and market-analysis platform that turns raw match data into contextual percentiles, player roles, statistical similarity and ranked recruitment shortlists — with the reasoning behind every result kept visible.

principles.peerGroupTitle: Compared against the right peer group
principles.peerGroup: Percentiles are position-scoped and measured against a stated comparison population, shown beside every number.
principles.explainable: Every ranked candidate shows the components, weights and filters behind its position.
principles.sample: Every figure carries the minutes behind it and a sample label. Nobody is excluded for playing too little.
principles.fit: A score is statistical fit to a profile: not a scouting grade and not a probability.

limitations.strength: A 90th percentile in one competition is not a 90th in another. No competition-strength coefficient is applied.
limitations.marketTitle: Market value is not a transfer fee
limitations.market: Transfermarkt's crowd-sourced estimate: not an asking price, and no valuation model sits on top of it.

tasksHeading: What do you want to do?

find.title: Find players
find.description: Search and filter the whole player universe, with the minutes behind every figure.

similar.title: Find players like this one
similar.description: Start from a player you know and see who is statistically alike.

replace.title: Replace a player
replace.description: Start from someone in your squad and find alternatives by profile, role and market context.

brief.title: Build a recruitment brief
brief.description: Weight what the team needs and rank candidates against that brief.

opportunities.title: Spot market opportunities
opportunities.description: Screen for younger, cheaper or expiring-contract profiles using criteria you set.

shortlist.title: Keep a shortlist
shortlist.description: Save candidates, note your assessment and compare them side by side.
